messages:
Amy: Starting thread — Cobalt private deployment quiet window on 2026-03-18 01:00-02:00 UTC. Who's taking deploy ownership and smoke?
Ravi: I'll be deploy owner. Planning to kick at 01:05 after the final snapshot finishes. @Kenji you're still on the DB migration?
Kenji: Yep — I'll run `cobalt-migrate-v3`. ETA ~12m. Will post migration logs. If migration fails we do `cobalt-rollback-migrations` + snapshot restore.
Marta: I'll run smoke checks (app health + sample inference). My checklist: 
```
- verify VPC nodes report READY
- run smoke script: ./smoke/cobalt_smoke.sh
- check 95p latency < 250ms
- run sample prompts against model:v3 (10 queries)
- confirm routing and model weights loaded
```
Amy: Is the PR merged to production branch? Any last-minute CR comments?
Ravi: PR was merged and tagged `release/cobalt-v3`. Canary VM is spinning up now. @deploy-bot will post deploy events.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for 2026-03-18T01:05:00Z to cobalt-private (owner: Ravi). Will post status updates here.
Marta: Heads-up: I'll be in the lounge channel during the window. If smoke fails I'll post FAIL + short logs and escalate to @Amy — we abort and restore snapshot.
Kenji: One note: schema change adds column `embed_metadata` DEFAULT NULL — backwards-compatible, should be safe. Rollback plan stands.
Amy: Who's executing snapshot restore if needed? We should have a named lead.
Ravi: I'll own the restore. Plan: stop traffic, run `restore-snapshot cobalt-20260318-0000`, verify services restart, then @Kenji verifies migration state. I'll also page oncall if needed.
Sasha: Can someone ping infra to monitor network rules during cutover? We don't want an accidental block.
Amy: Good call. @Ben can you watch firewall rules (`cobalt-allow-internal`) and VPC peerings at 01:00 UTC?
Ben: On it. I'll be in the channel at 00:55 UTC and will confirm rule checks.
Ravi: Final smoke timeout is 15m after migration finishes. If not green by 01:25 UTC we trigger rollback.
Marta: Copy — I'll post a single-line PASS/FAIL with brief notes and paste the truncated logs.
Amy: OK. One last ask: if anyone is going to be AFK during the window, say now.
Kenji: I'll be present until 02:00 UTC.
Ben: Same.
Sasha: Available.
Ravi: Available. :thumbsup:
Amy: Thanks everyone — please react with :thumbsup: when ready and we'll treat this as the canonical runbook for the window.
